data.one_liner: A draggable home page widget with expandable header and customizable body
data.what_it_does: Provides a Scaffold‑like widget that lets the header stretch and collapse with drag gestures. It supports custom header, body, bottom sheet, navigation bar, and scroll physics.
use_when: You need a sliding home page with a stretchable header
You want a single widget that handles scrolling and layout of header and body
You prefer a declarative API without extra state management
avoid_when: You need complex state management or custom animations beyond what the widget offers
You are building a highly custom layout that requires fine‑grained control over scroll physics
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports multiple platforms (android, ios, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited to the provided layout; not a full state‑management solution
No built‑in theming or animation beyond basic scroll physics
Relies on Flutter’s Scaffold and Sliver under the hood
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import draggable_home.dart
data.minimal_example:
DraggableHome(
  title: Text("Title"),
  headerWidget: headerWidget(),
  body: [
    Container(height: 200, color: Colors.blue),
    ListView.builder(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 0),
      physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      shrinkWrap: true,
      itemCount: 10,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) => Card(
        child: ListTile(title: Text("Item "+index.toString())),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
